headline: Logitech unveils new Pro gaming mouse and accessories
summary: Logitech has unveiled several new accessories in its Pro gaming line, including a $60 mouse pad and an updated G Pro Superstrike mouse that costs $20 more. The mouse uses haptic actuators instead of mechanical switches, reducing latency and letting users customize the feel of each click.

claims.statement: Logitech unveiled new gaming accessories in its Pro line, including a $60 mouse pad

sources.quote: Logitech just unveiled several new gaming accessories in its Pro line
For $60 it had better be a pretty incredible mouse pad.

claims.statement: The G Pro Superstrike mouse uses haptic actuators instead of mechanical switches, reducing latency and allowing a custom click feel

sources.quote: The G Pro Superstrike mouse is one of Logitech's most interesting products. Unlike other gaming mice, it has haptic actuators beneath its two main buttons instead of mechanical switches, which decreases latency and allows for a custom click feel

claims.statement: The new mouse costs $20 more than its predecessor

sources.quote: Logitech’s new haptics-based gaming mouse is a little better and $20 more
